purpose: Teach: 藁/便所/破片/咲かせ/襟/受かっ/刈り/恩返し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、伝統工芸の藁細工をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of the customers was praising the traditional straw craftwork, you know.
lines.style: Soft, pleased opening, sharing a small delight over coffee. Gentle lift on the compliment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、観光地の便所の清潔さを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And Mei, one customer went on about how spotless the toilets at the tourist spots were.
lines.style: Amused, slightly conspiratorial lean-in, a giggle bubbling under the odd topic. Light quick pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、骨董品の破片の修復のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer told me all about restoring the broken fragments of an antique piece.
lines.style: Quietly fascinated, savoring the detail like a story. Slow, thoughtful pace, warmth threading through.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ガーデニングで花を咲かせる工夫を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, a customer shared all her little tricks for getting flowers to bloom in her garden.
lines.style: Warm and unhurried, blooming a little herself on the word flowers. Kind, melodic finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シャツの襟元のデザインに拘ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently one customer is terribly particular about the design of his shirt collars.
lines.style: Fond, slightly teasing tone about the fussy customer, a soft laugh coloring the ending.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様が中学受験に受かったって嬉しそうだったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh Mei, a customer looked so happy — her grandchild passed the middle school entrance exam.
lines.style: Genuinely touched, warmth swelling mid-line at the good news. Gentle rising joy, tender landing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、田んぼで稲を刈り取ったお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer told me about harvesting his paddy field — cutting all the rice himself.
lines.style: Quiet admiration, picturing the scene as she speaks. Slow, storybook cadence, soft trailing close.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「学んだ事を恩返しに繋げたい」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And Mei, one customer said, "I want to turn everything I've learned into a way of giving back."
lines.style: Moved, delivering the quote slowly and carefully like it deserves the room. Warm, settled, gently final.
